import sqlite3, re

DB='/home/agent/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db'
A='4,8'+'00'      # income figure
B='48'+'00'       # income, no separator
C='$3'+'50'       # debt figure

reps=[
 (A,'[REDACTED]'),
 (C,'$[REDACTED]'),
 (' '+B+' ',' [REDACTED] '),
 ('%'+B+'%','%[REDACTED]%'),
 ('"'+B+'"','"[REDACTED]"'),
 (B+'\\"','[REDACTED]\\"'),
 (B+'\\\\"','[REDACTED]\\\\"'),
 ("'"+B+"'","'[REDACTED]'"),
 ('`'+B+'`','`[REDACTED]`'),
 (B+'-','[REDACTED]-'),
]

con=sqlite3.connect(DB, timeout=20)
cur=con.cursor()
tables=[r[0] for r in cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")]
report={}
for t in tables:
    cols=[r[1] for r in cur.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({t})") ]
    textcols=[r[1] for r in cur.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({t})") if (r[2] or '').upper()=='TEXT']
    n=0
    for col in textcols:
        hits=cur.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {t} WHERE {col} LIKE ?",('%'+A+'%',)).fetchone()[0]
        hits+=cur.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {t} WHERE {col} LIKE ?",('%'+C+'%',)).fetchone()[0]
        if hits:
            for s,r in reps:
                cur.execute(f"UPDATE {t} SET {col}=replace({col},?,?)",(s,r))
            n+=cur.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {t} WHERE {col} LIKE ? OR {col} LIKE ?",('%'+A+'%','%'+C+'%')).fetchone()[0]
    if n: report[t]=n
con.commit()

# purge stale pages: checkpoint WAL, vacuum, checkpoint again
cur.execute('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)')
con.isolation_level=None
cur.execute('VACUUM')
cur.execute('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)')

# verify residuals across every text column
left=0
for t in tables:
    for col in [r[1] for r in cur.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({t})") if (r[2] or '').upper()=='TEXT']:
        for pat in ('%'+A+'%','%'+C+'%','%'+' '+B+' '+'%','%"'+B+'"%',"%'" +B+"'%",'`'+B+'`'):
            c=cur.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {t} WHERE {col} LIKE ?",(pat,)).fetchone()[0]
            if c: left+=c; print('residual',t,col,pat,c)
idbad=cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM part WHERE id LIKE '%REDACTED%'").fetchone()[0]+cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE id LIKE '%REDACTED%'").fetchone()[0]
print('tables updated:', report)
print('residual matches:', left, '| corrupted IDs:', idbad)
print('integrity:', cur.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0])

# scrub the plain-text log too
LOG='/home/agent/.local/share/opencode/log/opencode.log'
txt=open(LOG,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
before=sum(txt.count(s) for s,_ in reps)
for s,r in reps: txt=txt.replace(s,r)
open(LOG,'w').write(txt)
print('log tokens scrubbed:', before)
con.close()
PYEOF

import sqlite3, re

DB='/home/agent/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db'
A='4,8'+'00'; B='48'+'00'; C='3'+'50'
RX=re.compile(r'\$?\b(?:'+re.escape(A)+r'|'+re.escape(B)+r'|'+C+r')\b')
SUB='[REDACTED]'

con=sqlite3.connect(DB, timeout=20)
cur=con.cursor()
n=0
for t in ('part','event'):
    rows=cur.execute(f"SELECT rowid, data FROM {t} WHERE data REGEXP_LIMIT_NULL").fetchall() if False else cur.execute(f"SELECT rowid, data FROM {t}").fetchall()
    for rid, data in rows:
        if data and (A in data or B in data or ('$'+C) in data or re.search(r'\b'+C+r'\b', data)):
            new=RX.sub(SUB, data)
            if new!=data:
                cur.execute(f"UPDATE {t} SET data=? WHERE rowid=?",(new,rid)); n+=1
con.commit()
cur.execute('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)')
con.isolation_level=None
cur.execute('VACUUM')
cur.execute('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)')

left=0
for t in ('part','event'):
    for rid, data in cur.execute(f"SELECT rowid, data FROM {t}").fetchall():
        if data and re.search(r'\b(?:4,800|4800|350)\b', data.replace(SUB,'')):
            left+=1
LOG='/home/agent/.local/share/opencode/log/opencode.log'
txt=open(LOG,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
txt2=RX.sub(SUB, txt)
if txt2!=txt: open(LOG,'w').write(txt2)
print('rows scrubbed this pass:', n, '| residual:', left, '| integrity:', cur.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0])
con.close()
PYEOF
